verdict.rationale: Canva ships a documented MCP server with write-capable tools (design generation, editing, export, comments) plus Connect APIs and Apps SDK for programmatic design creation/modification, and runtime probes confirm the hosted MCP endpoint is live and speaks the MCP/OAuth flow. missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on confirmation of successful write operations (create/modify) beyond docs and a single auth-handshake probe, and no evidence of real-world community usage reports validating reliability.
